entities.name: Maria Christina Bruhn
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maria Christina Bruhn was a Swedish chemist and inventor, likely to be the first patented female inventor of her country. She created a gunpowder packaging that would later be used in the Swedish army for several generations.
